definitions.explanation: A small cloth bag closed by pulling a cord through its mouth, used for coins, small items or a lunch box. A traditional accessory with kimono and yukata.

examples.japanese: {巾着|きんちゃく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{小銭|こぜに}→小銭：02759_kozeni⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: To put coins in a drawstring pouch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{巾着|きんちゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My mother gave me a handmade drawstring pouch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{浴衣|ゆかた}→浴衣：04081_yukata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代|か}わり→代わり：01296_kawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{巾着|きんちゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: When I wear a yukata, I carry a drawstring pouch instead of a wallet.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {巾着袋|きんちゃくぶくろ}: drawstring bag
- {巾着|きんちゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{締|し}める→締める：10057_shimeru⟧: to pull a pouch shut
- ⟦お{弁当|べんとう}→お弁当：02864_obentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巾着|きんちゃく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to carry a lunch box in a drawstring bag

RELATED WORDS:
- {腰巾着|こしぎんちゃく}: a hanger-on who sticks close to a superior (literally, a pouch hung at the waist)
- {巾着|きんちゃく} in ⟦おでん→おでん：14727_oden⟧: a pouch of fried tofu filled with rice cake, tied with a strip of gourd
- {巾着切|きんちゃくき}り: an old word for a pickpocket
